player_prompt.intro:
Wo reko {color} wɔ Breakthrough agorɔ mu. Wo tu {direction} wɔ {board_size}x{board_size} agorɔpono so.
Wɔ wo bere mu no, wo betumi atu agorɔ korɔ no kwan korɔ kɔnɔ anaa kɔnɔ kɔnɔ.
Agorɔ korɔ no betumi atu kɔnɔ kɔnɔ sɛ ɔpɔnɔ korɔ bi wɔ hɔ, na sɛ wɔtu kɔnɔ kɔnɔ no, wo betumi atu agorɔ korɔ no kɔnɔ.
Sɛ wo tu kɔnɔ kɔnɔ a ɔpɔnɔ korɔ bi wɔ mu, wo faa no, na ɔpɔnɔ korɔ no kɔ awiee.
Fa UCI-te sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu wɔ brackets, e.g. [a2a3] sɛ wo tu a2 kɔ a3.
* 'a' gyina hɔ ma kɔlɔm a ɛwɔ benkum, '1' yɛ adwuma a ɛwɔ ase (White nkyerɛkyerɛmu).
* Black nkyerɛkyerɛmu no, adwuma a ɛwɔ soro (adwuma 8 ma 8x8). White nkyerɛkyerɛmu no, adwuma a ɛwɔ ase (adwuma 1 ma 8x8).
Ogyina hɔ ma agorɔ korɔ a ɛdikan kɔ ɔpɔnɔ korɔ no nkyerɛkyerɛmu no, na wo di nkunim. Sɛ wo agorɔ korɔ nyinaa faa, wo di nkoguo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Yɛsrɛ sɛ fa abodin a wɔabobɔ no yɛ bracketed te sε [a2a3].
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Akwantu no nni boayikuw no mu.
invalid_move.illegal: Saa kwan no nni Nhyehyɛe a Ɛkyere Adeyɛ So mmara so anaasɛ ɛnyɛ wo de.

outcome.white_reached: Abere no, na aborɔnoma adu wɔn a wɔyɛ tuntum fie.
